description: Packs to read. Each hex is a whole file and file_name its name in packs/. pack-1 to pack-5 hold what c1 to c5 add, one pack per push as §9.5 suggests, with zstd frames in pack-2 and pack-3; pack-5 carries a blob that c4 pruned again. A writer need not reproduce these bytes (compressed payloads and record order are free, §9.5); a reader must read them. variants: expect ok, newer or invalid; reason is informative.
